ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Social Inequality This course will examine classical and contemporary perspectives for understanding social inequality at the individual, societal and global level. The topics covered include but are not limited to, Social inequality in classical social theory, the development of market capitalism, the development of the wage labor force, the development and maintenance of gender and racial inequality, the politics of inequality, the contemporary middle class, inequalities in the legal system, inequalities in the professions and contemporary issues in the study of social inequality.
